title: Commercial Fleet Account Standing and the Fleet Order Deposit Rate
content:
Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement. The order deposit rate on a reserved fleet unit follows the buyer's commercial standing, which is read from the buyer's account with Service Accounts and Repair Orders: its tier, its status and its opening date.

**Definition.** The buyer's active service account is the buyer's service account in active status, identified by its tier.

**Rate rule.**
- A buyer holding a **Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30** in active status, opened **at least 60 whole months** before the handling date, pays an order deposit rate of **5 percent (0.05)**.
- A buyer holding a **Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15** in active status pays **7.5 percent (0.075)**. So does a buyer holding a **Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30** in active status opened **fewer than 60 whole months** before the handling date.
- For every other buyer, no commercial-standing rate applies.

Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the opening date to the handling date. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

### Standing grid

| Active service account tier | Opened before the handling date | Order deposit rate |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 60 whole months or more | 5 percent |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | fewer than 60 whole months | 7.5 percent |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | any age | 7.5 percent |
| any other tier, or no service account in active status | any age | no commercial-standing rate |

### Boundary (hypothetical dates)
- A Net 30 account opened 20 April of one year; handling date 20 April five years later. Sixty whole months have passed, so the rate is 5 percent.
- Same account; handling date 19 April five years later. Only 59 whole months have passed, so the rate is 7.5 percent.
- A Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 on credit hold is not in active status. It earns neither rate.
